PingGuard for Minecraft **26.3** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3).

* `pingguard-*.jar` goes into the server's `mods/` folder. Players can install the same jar too (optional): they then get the HUD from the mod instead of the resource pack.
* `PingGuard-ResourcePack-*.zip` is only needed if you want to host the pack somewhere else (`resourcePackUrl` in the config). By default the server hands it out by itself on the game port.
